members.rouan:
The combination of over 15 years of entrepreneurship and my passion for technology led me to focus on how artificial intelligence can generate a real and positive impact on people, organizations, and society.
Today, I have the privilege of serving as an advisor at the Argentine Society of Artificial Intelligence, an organization that seeks to coordinate efforts among entrepreneurs, researchers, developers, and public sectors to promote the ethical and responsible development of AI in our country, with a focus on collective well-being.
In addition, I support transformation processes in companies through my role as an AI consultant, specializing in automation, data analytics, and the strategic adoption of new technologies. I'm especially interested in working with teams that are just starting to explore these paths and need both a strategic and hands-on approach.
I also actively participate in educational spaces:
As a professor at UTN in a course on Applied Artificial Intelligence.
At UBA's IA Lab.
In a prompting course at the Subsecretariat of Development of San Martín.
And as a tutor in the postgraduate program in Strategic Management of Artificial Intelligence and Business Automation at UCEMA.
I keep learning and sharing, with the conviction that AI can be a powerful tool to improve how we work, make decisions, and build the future.
If you're looking to transform your processes with artificial intelligence, feel free to contact me 📩🚀

desc_mission: The mission of Olmond Consulting is to empower organizations through artificial intelligence, data analytics, and RPA, offering innovative and customized solutions that drive their digital transformation. We are committed to being strategic partners to our clients, guiding them through the evolving technological landscape with cutting-edge consulting, development, and AI training, aiming to enhance their competitiveness and operational efficiency.
desc_vision: Olmond Consulting aims to become the leading artificial intelligence consultancy in Latin America, recognized for its ability to anticipate and adapt to technological trends, promoting success and innovation in every organization it advises. We aspire to transform the business landscape by creating an ecosystem where AI technology is accessible, understandable, and maximally utilized by companies of all sizes and sectors.
